question: On the frozen Qwen3.5/ForkAudit vLLM-Q16 stack, do two request-local full-model steps enqueued by two host workers onto two distinct CUDA streams preserve the ownership, lifecycle, and exact-output invariants of an otherwise identical serialized execution across cancel, zero-scrub, and same-slot replacement?

model.attention_operator: vLLM 0.26 unified_attention over ForkAudit Q16 block pools

input_binding.prior_static_manifest_role: input-only reuse; no Round-23 output is reused

arms.execution: one host thread and the default CUDA stream; synchronize after every request step
arms.role: same-input full-vocabulary, token, final logical-KV, and final GDN oracle

arms.execution: two host worker threads released by one barrier, each enqueuing one complete request-local model step on its own non-default CUDA stream

lifecycle_schedule_per_arm: Acquire initial slots 0 and 1 and verify pairwise-disjoint private reservations.
Execute one step for both initial requests; the concurrent arm must show positive overlap between the two CUDA-event intervals.
Close and cancel slot 1, require the pre-scrub RECLAIM_NOT_ZERO positive control, zero-scrub every private K/V page, increment its epoch, and reject the stale lease.
Rewind only the cancelled suffix slot, acquire one replacement in slot 1, and require exact physical-reservation reuse plus live disjointness from survivor slot 0.
Execute survivor round 1 and replacement round 0; the concurrent arm must again show positive overlap between the two CUDA-event intervals.
Replay the lifecycle receipt and compare both arms.

outcome_policy.no_positive_stream_overlap: completed treatment-validity failure; do not cite as concurrency evidence
outcome_policy.pre-model or infrastructure failure: invalid operational attempt, not scientific evidence

resource_requirement.shared_state: model and PG19 assets are read-only; output and compiler caches are experiment-private

claim_boundary.established_only_if_positive: two request-local full-model steps on one frozen Qwen3.5/ForkAudit vLLM-Q16 H20 stack retain exact semantics and auditable private-page/lifecycle invariants while their distinct CUDA-stream execution intervals overlap before and after cancel--zero-scrub--same-slot replacement
not_established: simultaneous execution of individual CUDA kernels
native vLLM-engine scheduling or continuous batching
throughput, latency, QPS, capacity, or memory savings
safety for arbitrary cancellation timing or in-flight reclamation
